description: M5 control for hoffer at k=99999 (all labels), external-data replay settings (1000 epochs, patience 20). Hoffer cannot run with an empty unlabeled pool (HofferEntropyRegularizer.build_dataset raises 'requires unlabeled samples' at fold setup, whatever the weight), so this is the closest valid control: the unlabeled term at weight 0 exactly as make_phase2_ablations.ZERO_WEIGHT (the term an empty pool would feed is off), and unlabeled_source='labeled' only so build_dataset gets a non-empty pool; at weight 0 the engine never iterates it and trains on the labeled loader alone, with an unchanged epoch length (labeled + 0 split unlabeled).
name: full_external_0_hoffer
